top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Has Restored Key Pipeline to Half Its Capacity
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia has restored about half the flows through its cross-country oil pipeline bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, after drone strikes halted the key export route earlier this month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Puma opens U.S. distribution centers to third parties
top_signals.summary:
Puma has contracted with shipping giant Maersk to run its automated distribution centers in the U.S. with the proviso that unused space can be rented to other companies.

top_signals.title: Terror suspects wanted to do ‘big damage’ to air base used by US, Trump says
top_signals.summary: British police on Sunday arrested five men on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offenses near an air base that hosts U.S. Air Force personnel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: United States on track for record crude oil production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. crude oil production will average 13.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 13.7 million b/d set in 2025, in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).

top_signals.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce reflects on her time at the agency, what she still wanted to get done: ‘There’s no good time to leave’
top_signals.summary: After nearly a decade at the Securities and Exchange Commission, Hester Peirce is wrapping up her last week at the agency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
top_signals.summary: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry Hub.
